verses.1: And King David, who was old, came in those days. He was covered with clothes, and he couldn’t get any rest at all.
verses.2: And his servants said to him, “Ask for a young girl from the palace. Let her stand before the king. She will be your wife and sleep in your arms. May the king be pleased with her.”
verses.3: And they sought a beautiful girl throughout all the borders of Israel. They found Abisag the Shunammite, and they brought her to the king.
verses.4: And the young woman was extremely beautiful. She became the queen’s companion and served her. The king did not know about her existence at all.
verses.5: And Adonias, son of Haggith, was made king. He was given a chariot and horses, and fifty men ran before him.
verses.6: And his father did not distress him from his youth, saying, “Do you really know what you’re doing?” But he was also a man of great virtue. He was the son of Abshalom.
verses.7: And his words were shared with Joab son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar, the priest. They helped each other in accordance with Adonijah’s wishes.
verses.8: And Zadok, the priest, and his sons, son of Jehovah-En-Dor. And the prophet, and Shemiya, and Rehi, and the nobles who were not with David.
verses.9: And Adonijah offered sacrifices of sheep and grain. He also burned incense with the altar that was located near the entrance. He called out to all his brothers, the sons of the king, and to all the people of Judah, who were the servants of the king.
verses.10: And he did not call upon the prophet Nathan, nor his sons, nor the nobles, nor Solomon, his brother.
verses.11: And Nathan said to Sarah, the mother of Moses, “Do not listen when Adonijah, son of Haggai, says that he is king. Our king is David.”
verses.12: And now, I urge you to give me a suggestion. Please protect your soul, and also protect the soul of your son Solomon.
verses.13: Go, and come before King David. Say to him, “You are not the true king. Your words mean nothing. Solomon, your son, will rule after me. He will sit on my throne. But you, king Adonai, are nothing but a false prophet.”
verses.14: Now, I will go there to speak with the king. I will follow after you, and I will share with you what I have to say.
verses.15: And the girl went to see the king. The king was very old. And Abishag served the king.
verses.16: And the daughter of seven years old came forward and bowed to the king. The king said, “What do you want?”
verses.17: And Adonai said to him, “You will indeed be exalted by the LORD your God, for your son Solomon will reign after you. And he will sit on my throne.”
verses.18: And now, behold, Adonai is king. And now, Adonai the king does not know anything.
verses.19: And he sacrificed sheep and goats in great numbers. He called out to all the king’s sons, as well as to the priest Ebedyar, to Yoab, the leader of the singers, and to Shlomo, your servant. But none of them came.
verses.20: And you, Lord King, are the eyes of all Israel. It is your duty to tell them who will sit on the throne after you.
verses.21: And it would be when King Adonai lay down with his fathers. Then I, along with my son Solomon, would commit sins.
verses.22: And now, she is still talking with the king. And the prophet has given her instructions.
verses.23: And they said to the king, “Look, the prophet has brought him here. He came before the king and bowed down to the king’s feet.”
verses.24: And Nathan said to the king, “You said, ‘Adoniyahu will reign after me.’ And he shall sit on my throne.”
verses.25: For when the day came, the priest and the Levites offered many sacrifices. They called upon all the king’s sons and the officers of the court. They ate and drank before him. Then they said, “Long live the king, Adonai!”
verses.26: And I, your servant, and also the priest Zechariah, and his son Solomon, who is wise. They were all your servants.
verses.27: If this happens from the king’s throne, and you do not know who will sit on the throne after him…
verses.28: And King David said, “Call me my daughter.” Then she came before the king and stood before him.
verses.29: And the king sat down and said, “May the LORD live! He has saved my soul from all evil.”
verses.30: For when I promised you in the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, that Solomon, your son, would reign after me. And he shall sit on my throne. So I will do today what I have promised.
verses.31: And the daughter of seven years old ruled over the land. She bowed down to the king and said, “Long live my king David forever!”
verses.32: And King David said, “Call to me the priest Kishai, the prophet Nathan, and Benjamin, son of Jehoiada.” Then they came before the king.
verses.33: And the king said to them, “Take your servants with you, and ride on Shlomo’s chariot. Then bring him to me at Gilboa.”
verses.34: And the priest Zadok anointed him, and the prophet gave him a message to the king of Israel. They also put a ring on his finger, and they said, “May the king Solomon live long in power!”
verses.35: And you went after him. He came and sat on my throne. He became king under me. I commanded him to be the judge over Israel and over the Jews.
verses.36: And Bnei Yahuda, son of Yehoyada, knew about the king’s plan. He said, “Amen!” Then Jehovah, the God of Adonai, said to him, “You shall speak as the Lord says.”
verses.37: Just as Jehovah was with Adonai, the king, so too He will be with Solomon. His throne will grow higher than that of Adonai, the king David.
verses.38: And Zadok, the priest, and the prophet, and Benyahu, son of Jehoyada, came. I also went with them. They rode on Solomon’s horse during the time of King David’s reign. They traveled with him to Gihon.
verses.39: And Zadok, the priest, took the lampstand from the tabernacle. He then lit it on the altar. And all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”
verses.40: And all the people rose up beside them. The people were filled with joy and celebration. The earth trembled at their voices.
verses.41: And Adonai heard it, along with all those who were with him. They were all hungry. And Yoav heard the sound of the cry for help. He said, “What is the cause of this cry for help?”
verses.42: Then he spoke to us, and there came Jonathan, son of Abiathar, the priest. He said, “Lord, come now, for you are a good speaker.”
verses.43: And Jonathan said to Adonai, “But our king David has ruled over Solomon.”
verses.44: And the king sent out his priests, Nathan the prophet, and Benyahu son of Jehoyada. They rode with him on the king’s chariot.
verses.45: And Zadok the priest and the prophet brought him to the king in Gihon. They went up there with joy, and the people cheered loudly. That was the sound they heard.
verses.46: And Solomon also sat on the throne of kings.
verses.47: And also, the king’s servants came to bless our king David. They said, “It is good for God that His name be glorified through you. May His throne be exalted above yours.” Then the king bowed down before the bed on which the king was lying.
verses.48: And in this manner, the king said, “Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, who has given me this day to sit on my throne, and my eyes see.”
verses.49: And all the priests who were in the house of God became frightened and stood up. Each of them went his own way.
verses.50: And Adoniyahhu feared Shlomo. He got up and went away, strengthening the strength of his eyes.
verses.51: And he told Solomon, “Look! Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon. He also holds the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Today, King Solomon will sit on my throne, if he kills his servant in the Temple.’”
verses.52: And Solomon said, “If a man is born of a noble family, he will not fall from his lofty position in society. But if he falls into trouble and dies, then…”
verses.53: And King Solomon sent for him. He came down from the throne, came forward, and bowed down to King Solomon. Then Solomon said to him, “Go back to your house.”
